spec.title: Home: Energy consumption

spec.expr:
(
  sort_by_label(
    sum(
      last_over_time(
          {__name__=~"(consumer|ext|aux)EnergyDaily", title=~".+", title!~"$consumerBlocklist|$extBlocklist|$auxBlocklist"}[$__range] offset 1ms)
    ) by (title),
    "title"
  )
)
or
(
  label_set(
    sum(
      last_over_time(homeEnergyDaily[$__range] offset 1ms)
    )
    -
    sum(
      last_over_time(
          {__name__=~"(consumer|ext|aux)EnergyDaily", title=~".+", title!~"$consumerBlocklist|$extBlocklist|$auxBlocklist"}[$__range] offset 1ms)
    ),
    "title",
    "zz_otherConsumers"
  )
)

# 1. Battery Difference
label_set(
  (
    sum(last_over_time(batteryEnergyChargedDaily[$__range] offset 1ms)) by (month)
    -
    sum(last_over_time(batteryEnergyDischargedDaily[$__range] offset 1ms)) by (month)
  ),
  "series", "_1_battery"
)

or

# 2. Home
label_set(
  sum(last_over_time(homeEnergyDaily[$__range] offset 1ms)) by (month), 
  "series", "_2_home"
)

or

# 2. Loadpoints
label_copy(
  sum(last_over_time(loadpointEnergyDaily{loadpoint!~"$loadpointBlocklist"}[$__range] offset 1ms)) by (month, loadpoint),
  "loadpoint", "series"
)

# 1. PV
label_set(
  sum(last_over_time(pvEnergyDaily[$__range] offset 1ms)) by (month), 
  "series", "_1_pv"
)

or

# 2. Grid import
label_set(
  sum(last_over_time(gridEnergyImportDaily[$__range] offset 1ms)) by (month), 
  "series", "_2_gridImport"
)

or

# 3. Home
label_set(
  sum(last_over_time(homeEnergyDaily[$__range] offset 1ms)) by (month) * (-1), 
  "series", "_3_home"
)

or

# 4. Loadpoints
label_copy(
  (sum(last_over_time(loadpointEnergyDaily{loadpoint!~"$loadpointBlocklist"}[$__range] offset 1ms)) by (month, loadpoint) * -1), 
  "loadpoint", "series"
)

or

# 5. Feed in
label_set(
  sum(last_over_time(gridEnergyExportDaily[$__range] offset 1ms)) by (month) * (-1), 
  "series", "zz_gridExport"
)
